mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ad_conversion_projection_fact(event_id,qualification_id,visible_receipt_id,outcome_id,conversion_event_id,advertiser_id,budget_date,amount,payload_hash,payload_json) VALUES(#{eventId},#{qualificationId},#{visibleReceiptId},#{outcomeId},#{conversionEventId},#{advertiserId},#{budgetDate},#{amount},#{payloadHash},#{payloadJson}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT payload_hash FROM ad_conversion_projection_fact WHERE event_id=#{eventId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ad_conversion_projection_daily(advertiser_id,budget_date,conversion_count,charged_amount) VALUES(#{advertiserId},#{budgetDate},1,#{amount}) ON CONFLICT(advertiser_id,budget_date) DO UPDATE SET conversion_count=ad_conversion_projection_daily.conversion_count+1, charged_amount=ad_conversion_projection_daily.charged_amount+excluded.charged_amount, updated_at=clock_timestamp()
